# WC29 · Patient 360 · hồ sơ tổng hợp chưa có liệu trình và đơn thuốc

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **none** · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/care-finance.js#planPanel`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/care-finance.js#prescriptionPanel`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `care-finance.js › planPanel(p)` and `prescriptionPanel(p)` for P037 (Nguyễn Ánh Dương): both lists are empty; the hero eyebrow reads "Chưa có lịch hôm nay".
- Inventory note: One of the ten CRM demo patients (P037): empty service-plan panel, empty prescription panel and the status "Chưa có lịch hôm nay" in the hero eyebrow.
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=edit` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=care` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-service` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `careNav=cashier` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P037\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"}; it must show "Chưa có dịch vụ gắn với hồ sơ".

Kit components used: Button×13, Card×11, Badge×3, EmptyState×3, Tabs×1; shared pieces: Notice×3. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- (old web notice) "Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- Empty texts: "Chưa có dịch vụ gắn với hồ sơ.", "Chưa có đơn thuốc." (and "Chưa có đơn từ catalog." in the catalog panel).
